meta.name: airunway-aks-setup
meta.description: Set up AI Runway on AKS — from bare cluster to running model. Covers cluster verification, controller install, GPU assessment, provider setup, and first deployment. WHEN: "setup AI Runway", "onboard AKS cluster", "install AI Runway", "airunway setup", "deploy model to AKS", "GPU inference on AKS", "KAITO setup on AKS", "run LLM on AKS", "vLLM on AKS", "set up model serving on AKS", "AI Runway controller".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将AI Runway快速部署到Azure Kubernetes集群
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在Azure上搭建AI推理环境
copy.tagline_en: Deploy AI Runway onto an AKS cluster in minutes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to set up AI inference on Azure

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会按顺序:检查集群、安装 AI Runway 控制器、评估 GPU、安装推理供应商(KAITO 等)、部署并验证第一个模型,每步核对状态并征得确认。
howto.when: 当你说出“setup AI Runway”“install AI Runway”等指令,或要求在这个 AKS 集群上部署模型、跑 LLM 推理时触发。

say.text: 帮我在现有 AKS 集群上安装 AI Runway 并部署第一个模型。
say.note: 按第 1~5 步顺序执行并逐步确认。

say.text: 跳过前面的步骤,直接做 GPU 评估。
say.note: 对应 skip-to-step 3,会从该步接着处理。

say.text: 根据我的 GPU,推荐装 KAITO 还是 KubeRay?
say.note: 进入第 4 步,给出推荐并在确认后安装。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude proceeds in order: cluster check, AI Runway controller + CRD install, GPU assessment, provider install (KAITO etc.), first deployment and verification — checking state and confirming each step.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says “setup AI Runway”, “install AI Runway”, “deploy model to AKS”, or similar, or asks to run LLM inference on an existing AKS cluster.

say_en.text: Set up AI Runway on my existing AKS cluster and deploy the first model.
say_en.note: Runs steps 1–5 in order with confirmation.

say_en.text: Skip the earlier steps and do the GPU assessment directly.
say_en.note: Maps to skip-to-step 3 and resumes from that step.

say_en.text: Based on my GPUs, do you recommend KAITO or KubeRay?
say_en.note: Goes to step 4, recommends a provider, then installs after confirmation.
